name: Calamari (Squid)
siboNotes: Naturally FODMAP-free protein that's well-tolerated in SIBO diets. Avoid breaded preparations which may contain wheat flour and garlic.
preparationTips: Choose plain grilled or sautéed calamari over breaded versions
Use garlic-infused oil instead of fresh garlic for flavoring
Cook quickly over high heat to prevent tough, rubbery texture
Season with low-FODMAP herbs like oregano, basil, or chives
nutritionalHighlights: High in complete protein (15-18g per serving)
Excellent source of vitamin B12 and selenium
Good source of phosphorus and copper
Low in calories and saturated fat
